answer_1.quote: We compare image representations from large vision models with textual representations of the same images from large language models.
answer_1.outputs: The paper studies alignment between vision and language models in the context of image captioning, where language models generate or represent captions corresponding to images.

answer_2.quote: To quantify alignment between representations from language and vision models, we use linear predictivity... Alignment is the average Pearson correlation between predicted and actual responses across all units and five cross-validation folds.

answer_4.quote: An open dataset of over 500K human preference judgments on text-to-image outputs, collected from 37K real-user prompts; each prompt has two generated images and a binary/tie preference label.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters provided binary preference judgments between two generated images for the same prompt, indicating which image better matches the text.
